title: JSA, Collyer Law, Argus Partners, IC RegFin Legal act on Meesho's ₹202 crore acquisition of Kirana Club
description: Meesho Limited has acquired 100% of the shareholding of Kirana Club Pte Ltd (together with the indirect acquisition of its Indian subsidiary, Retail Pulse Labs Private Limited) from its Promoters and other selling shareholders, for ₹202 crore.JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised Meesho on this acquisition.
